notes: SURPRISING, HIGH-VALUE FINDING: this is core Moodle (5.2.1), which ships a complete first-party 'ai' subsystem at public/ai/ with six live provider plugins already present: openai, azureai, gemini, awsbedrock, ollama, deepseek (each with its own classes/, db/, version.php) — this is provider-integration infrastructure, not a single vendor lock-in. Admin configuration pages: configure_providers.php, configure_actions.php. Webservice/external API functions listed above manage provider status/order/actions/policy. AUTH VERIFIED (independently re-checked): ai/classes/external/set_provider_status.php's execute() calls `require_capability('moodle/site:config', $context)` (line 66) after `self::validate_parameters(...)` — requires site-admin-level Moodle capability; Moodle's external_api framework additionally enforces session/webservice-token validation centrally for any call reaching execute() at all (calls are only reachable via webservice.php or ajax.php, both of which authenticate before dispatch). SCOPE CAVEAT: the functions verified here are admin PROVIDER-CONFIGURATION endpoints (which providers are enabled, in what order, with what policy) — I did not locate or trace a separate end-USER AI-generation-request endpoint (e.g. a student/teacher triggering an actual completion) in this pass; if one exists with different (possibly broader) auth, it was not found here and should not be assumed equally gated without further verification.
